data.name: Elango
data.gender_notes: Elango is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elango is a Tamil name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Surya is the god of the sun, and Elango is believed to be a variant of this name. The name is auspicious and is given to boys to bless them with the sun's energy and warmth. The name Elango carries the meaning “God of Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Elango usually hope their child will grow to embody god of sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with the radiant energy of the sun.
data.etymology: Elango belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elango total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
